purpose: Manual curation overrides for the auto-selector in fetch_sources.py. The selector matches query-expected titles by token overlap; when it selects a different work, the locator must be rejected so it can never enter the coverage matrix. Rejected selections are preserved under rejected_selected for audit.

reject_selected.mass_inflation_any: selected 2605.15576 'Regular black hole with sub-Planckian curvature...' is not a mass-inflation/Cauchy-horizon theorem paper; query matched only the phrase.
reject_selected.discovery_wcc_vacuum: selected 2006.01390 is a WCC test for a specific Reissner-Nordstrom spacetime, not an asymptotically flat vacuum result; not usable as a matrix anchor.
reject_selected.cgns_validity_v2: expected the Costa-Girao-Natario-Silva validity paper; selected 2004.02902 is a different (legitimate) paper. Keep the selection available but do not bind it to the expected-title slot; the matrix row uses the actual title and is re-keyed as costa_natario_extremal_wcc.
